_comment: Positive control for --assert. Each listed route is requested ONCE on a fresh server process with .next/cache/fetch-cache emptied, so it cannot borrow a query another route already cached. An isolated cold render fetches each distinct query once, so the expected count equals the baseline per-request count measured on origin/main d52d3eb6 (request-count-targets.json). A route that loses a Sanity read, or a counter that stopped counting, fails here. Tolerance 0. If a legitimate product change moves a value, the dev reports the measured number to the architect, who edits this file; the dev never edits it.
